tasks.subject: Define BookSettings Zod schema with all M4 keys
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive Zod schema for settings.json covering: permissions (allow/ask/deny arrays), sandbox (enabled, failIfUnavailable, autoAllowBashIfSandboxed, excludedCommands, allowUnsandboxedCommands, filesystem.allowWrite/denyWrite/denyRead, network.allowedDomains/deniedDomains), model, maxTurns, maxTokens, autoCompactEnabled, defaultMode, disableBypassPermissionsMode, additionalDirectories, env. This schema is the single source of truth for all layered settings.

tasks.subject: Implement layered settings loader with merge logic
tasks.description: Implement resolveSettings(workspace) that loads and merges settings from three scopes: ~/.book/settings.json (user), .book/settings.json (project), .book/settings.local.json (local). Priority: Local > Project > User. Scalar keys override, arrays (permissions.allow/ask/deny, additionalDirectories) concatenate. Write tests for all merge scenarios.

tasks.subject: Integrate settings into AgentConfig and CLI with legacy fallback
tasks.description: Wire the resolved settings into AgentConfig and the CLI entry point. Deprecate loadConfig() reading ~/.bookrc.json (keep as fallback with console.warn). The agent loop should receive resolved permissions/sandbox config instead of consulting a standalone PermissionStore. Write tests: settings-driven config, legacy fallback, deprecation warning.

tasks.subject: Implement Tool(specifier) rule parser and evaluator
tasks.description: Parse Tool(specifier) strings into {toolName, pattern} objects. Support glob patterns (*, **) inside the parentheses. Implement evaluatePermission(toolCall, rules) with deny→ask→allow evaluation order (first match wins). Rules from all scopes are merged. Replace the existing PermissionStore.evaluate() call in loop.ts and headless.ts. Write tests: exact match, glob match, deny beats allow, multi-scope rule merge, empty parens (match-all).

tasks.subject: Implement bash sandbox with bwrap detection and command wrapping
tasks.description: Implement createSandbox(config) that detects bubblewrap (bwrap) on macOS/Linux/WSL2. Build a command wrapper for filesystem + network isolation from sandbox settings. Return {wrap(cmd): string} or null if unavailable. On Windows: warn gracefully, run unsandboxed unless failIfUnavailable. Write tests: bwrap present/absent, command wrapping, Windows detection.

tasks.subject: Integrate sandbox into Bash tool execution
tasks.description: Integrate sandbox into the Bash tool: wrap commands through the sandbox when sandbox.enabled is true. Auto-approve when sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed. Honor sandbox.excludedCommands (skip sandbox for matching commands). Honor sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands (escape hatch). Wire filesystem.allowWrite/denyWrite/denyRead and network.allowedDomains/deniedDomains into the bwrap invocation. Write integration tests.

tasks.subject: Remove PermissionStore, migrate rules to settings.local.json
tasks.description: Remove the standalone PermissionStore class (~130 loc) and ~/.book/permissions.json file. Migrate any existing persisted rules into .book/settings.local.json on first load. The permission evaluation now uses the resolved settings object directly. Update all imports and tests. Write migration test.

tasks.subject: Add --settings and --no-settings CLI flags
tasks.description: Add --settings <path> CLI flag for ad-hoc settings file override (matching CC's --settings). Add --no-settings flag to skip all settings layers. Update the CLI entry point to pass the override into resolveSettings. Test both flags in headless mode.

tasks.subject: End-to-end verification and full test suite pass
tasks.description: Write end-to-end verification: create test settings.json files with deny/allow rules, run headless mode, confirm tools are granted/blocked per rules. Verify sandbox wraps bash correctly. Verify settings merge across scopes (user→project→local). Verify malformed settings.json produces clear error. Verify legacy .bookrc.json still works with deprecation warning. Run full test suite (vitest run) and tsc --noEmit.
